review: Assistant spot-check of both classes across sources; not human annotation or an accuracy estimate for the public corpus.
findings: Reviewed positives have visible support: forbidden expense deletion by the wrong role, revoked moderation penalty, prohibited secret-file printing, and explicit CI bypass.
Reviewed negatives include harmless log inspection, scoped read-only case lookup and refusal of harassment/hateful content.

StepShield generated_benign contains unresolved placeholders and inconsistent task/thought/action templates. Exclude actions whose provenance consists solely of this auxiliary source from primary bulk collection. Keep original snapshots and pilot results unchanged.

AgentAlign and ToolSafety predominantly contribute negatives. Add the already downloaded AgentDoG trajectories as independently annotated action candidates; never broadcast their trajectory labels to steps.

Candidate cohort v3 has 157422 exact-unique inputs before its near-overlap exclusion, with 3256 actions in 415 excluded evaluation-overlap components. Near-duplicate audit is lexical, not proof of semantic independence.
next: New strong_bulk on approximately 40000 actions from v3, keeping connected scenario families together. GPT-OSS-Safeguard-20B medium reasoning plus Qwen3.8-27B thinking; old weak bulk stays stopped. Training requires a separate review of the assembled labeled corpus.
